items.en: Russia follows its ballistic strike with a 580-drone wave heavy on jet-powered Gerans, hitting Kirovohrad Oblast hardest and severing a unique Dnipro power-line tower in Kyiv
items.nl: Rusland laat op de ballistische aanval een golf van 580 drones volgen met veel straalaangedreven Gerans, die Kirovohrad het zwaarst treft en in Kyiv een unieke hoogspanningsmast over de Dnipro doorsnijdt
items.sEn: From 18:00 on 14 October to 08:00 on 15 October, Russia launched two Kh-59 air-launched missiles (fired from over the Black Sea) and 580 drones of various types, including Shaheds and Gerbera decoys, according to Ukraine's Air Force. items.en: «Понад 52 тисячі цілей за місяць: Повітряні Сили оприлюднили результати роботи у вересні» (ArmyInform: More than 52,000 targets in a month: the Air Force publishes its September results)
items.nl: Meer dan 52.000 doelen in één maand: de Luchtmacht publiceert haar resultaten over september (ArmyInform)
items.sEn: ArmyInform, the news agency of the Ukrainian Ministry of Defence, reports the Ukrainian Air Force's results for September 2026, published on 10 October. According to the Air Force, Ukraine's Defence Forces destroyed more than 4,700 aerial targets during the month and also neutralised more than 48,000 tactical-level UA…

items.en: Ukraine hits two Russian missile-component plants in two nights: Almaz-Antey's Iskra in Ulyanovsk (Kh-59, Pantsir parts) and the Azov Optical-Mechanical Plant, which leaked files tie to at least seven missile programs including Kh-101 and Oreshnik
items.nl: Oekraïne treft in twee nachten twee Russische fabrieken van raketcomponenten: Iskra van Almaz-Antej in Oeljanovsk (onderdelen Kh-59, Pantsir) en de Optisch-Mechanische Fabriek Azov, die volgens gelekte documenten aan minstens zeven raketprogramma's levert, waaronder Kh-101 en Oresjnik
items.sEn: Ukrainian long-range drones struck JSC NPP 'Iskra Plant' in Ulyanovsk overnight on 24–25 September 2026, as part of a wider drone barrage on Russia.
